review.note: Extracted as text from the old lesson (content in lib/lessonData.ts and the components; lib/audioUtils.ts holds only audio code), then reviewed against the verified dataset. A line with "review" set is held (not shown) until a teacher resolves it. Dropped: the four Tajweed rules (Tajweed comes only from the reviewed dataset; the old quiz had no Tajweed question), the audio URLs and the reciter line, the typed basmala and whole-surah text on the intro card, the did-you-know line "hal ta'lam anna laylat al-qadri khayrun min alfi shahr ..." (it quotes ayah 3 whole; cut before the quote nothing is left), the quiz question "laylat al-qadri khayrun min kam shahr?" (four words of ayah 3 typed; same reason), the reflection idea "li-annaha khayrun min alfi shahr" (four words of ayah 3; same reason), and every hand-typed Quran string (replaced by positions). Cut: the intro stops before its quote of four words of ayah 3. The complete-the-ayah words are the answers of the old missing-word game; its hand-typed distractors not of this surah (katabnahu, qara'nahu, al-nujum, al-tuyur, aqallu, aktharu) are gone, as the game draws its options from these words. The old complete-the-ayah game's answers were two-word endings and are not carried. The old quiz had no categories (they were assigned here) and difficulty levels (not carried); two of its three complete-the-ayah questions had two-word answers and now ask for the next word only. Two word cards (alf shahr, matla' al-fajr) are two-word phrases; each points at its first word and is held. Emoji were stripped from the ends of the true/false options and the start of the reflection ideas. Matching-only aids, never stored: adraka (2:2, alif maqsura + dagger alif), wa- on al-ruh (4:3). Not carried (no field or no such game in the engine): the "Makki" surah type (disputed: the Madinah mushaf heads Al-Qadr Makki, but some, e.g. al-Waqidi, held it Madani), the intro quiz (name, ayah count), the ayah-ordering, start-end matching and build-the-ayah games, the three word-meaning games (they repeat the word list with shorter meanings), and the motivational lines. Head review: q2 held (typed option).

intro.text: سورة القدر تتحدث عن ليلة القدر، وهي ليلة عظيمة ومباركة نزل فيها القرآن الكريم
intro.review: CUT: the old intro ended "... wa-hiya khayrun min alfi shahr" (and it is better than a thousand months), four words of ayah 3 typed. The Quran never goes in prose, so the text stops before it (and its comma). Teacher to finish the sentence.

tafsir.text: يخبرنا الله أنه أنزل القرآن الكريم في ليلة عظيمة اسمها ليلة القدر.
يسأل الله سؤالاً ليبين لنا عظمة هذه الليلة: هل تعرف ما هي ليلة القدر؟
ليلة القدر أفضل من ألف شهر! يعني العبادة فيها أفضل من عبادة أكثر من 83 سنة.
في هذه الليلة تنزل الملائكة وجبريل عليه السلام إلى الأرض بأمر الله.
هذه الليلة كلها سلام وأمان ورحمة من الله حتى يطلع الفجر.

words.meaning: الشرف والعظمة، وليلة القدر هي الليلة العظيمة التي نزل فيها القرآن
ألف شهر تساوي أكثر من 83 سنة
words.review: PHRASE: the old card is the 2-word phrase at 3:5-6; the engine shows one word, so it points at the first word (3:5) and the meaning covers the whole phrase. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

words.meaning: مخلوقات نورانية خلقها الله لعبادته وطاعته
جبريل عليه السلام، وهو أعظم الملائكة
words.review: Adds that Jibril "is the greatest of the angels". That al-ruh here is Jibril is the view of most mufassirun; which angel is greatest is a matter scholars differ on. Teacher to keep or drop the second half.
PHRASE: the old card is the 2-word phrase at 5:4-5; the engine shows one word, so it points at the first word (5:4) and the meaning covers the whole phrase. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

quiz.question: من ينزل في ليلة القدر؟
quiz.review: TYPED: the right option "al-mala'ikah wa-al-ruh" is two words of ayah 4 typed by hand. Teacher to rephrase it in prose, or the option to become a position.

quiz.question: أكمل الآية
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old options were two-word endings: the answer "laylat al-qadr" (1:4-5) and three hand-typed distractors not of this surah (laylat al-'id, yawm al-jumu'ah, shahr ramadan). It now asks for the next word, laylah (1:4); the distractors shahr (3:6), al-fajr (5:5) and amr (4:9) are words of this surah.

quiz.question: أكمل الآية
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old options were two-word endings: the answer "matla' al-fajr" (5:4-5) and three hand-typed distractors not of this surah (ghurub al-shams, nisf al-layl, waqt al-zuhr). It now asks for the next word, matla' (5:4); the distractors alf (3:5), laylah (1:4) and amr (4:9) are words of this surah.

quiz.question: ليلة القدر تكون في شهر رمضان
أكمل
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old distractors (al-shams, al-nujum, al-riyah) were hand-typed, not of this surah; they are replaced by al-fajr (5:5), al-qadr (1:5) and shahr (3:6), words of this surah. The old prompt's dangling "wa-" moves into the answer word, wa-al-ruh (4:3).

lessons.text: ليلة القدر ليلة عظيمة ومباركة نزل فيها القرآن الكريم.
القرآن الكريم نعمة عظيمة من الله يجب أن نحافظ عليه.
العبادة في ليلة القدر لها أجر عظيم جداً عند الله.
الملائكة تنزل في ليلة القدر وهذا يدل على عظمتها.
يجب أن نحرص على قيام ليلة القدر والدعاء فيها.
lessons.review: A good lesson, but not one the surah itself teaches: it praises the night; standing in prayer and making du'a in it come from the hadith (e.g. "whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and hope of reward", al-Bukhari and Muslim). Teacher to keep or drop.

reflection.question: لماذا تعتبر ليلة القدر ليلة عظيمة ومباركة؟
ideas: لأنها ليلة سلام وأمان حتى الفجر

didYouKnow.text: هل تعلم أن الملائكة تنزل إلى الأرض في ليلة القدر؟
هل تعلم أن ليلة القدر تكون في شهر رمضان المبارك؟
هل تعلم أن القرآن الكريم نزل في ليلة القدر؟
هل تعلم أن ليلة القدر ليلة سلام وأمان حتى طلوع الفجر؟
